preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 250 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(S) <= 60 and 1 <= len(P) <= 60 for S, P in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the lengths of S and P are between 1 and 60 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(S.isalpha() and P.isalpha() for S, P in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, both S and P consist only of alphabetic characters.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout[i] == 'Possible' if is_possible(S, P) else stdout[i] == 'Impossible' for i, (S, P) in enumerate(test_cases))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is 'Possible' if P can be formed by inserting a copy of S into S exactly once, otherwise 'Impossible'.
